text:
mei: rolling orionx-v1-int8 to sampling canary — smoke shows NBSP/ZWJ insertions around CJK numbers and occasional Arabic paren mirroring.
rajesh: greedy/beam look fine? sampling only?
mei: sampling only. quick minimal repro below (seeded):
mei: ```
input: 今日の価格は１,200－です。(続き)
fp16_out: 今日の価格は１,200－です。(続き)
int8_out: 今日の価格は１,200 -です。(続き)
```
anya: NBSP before the hyphen suggests subtoken merge difference after quantization. could be logits drift that sampling amplifies.
marta: we'll add a small eval-harness assertion to fail on control/ZWJ/ZWNJ/NBSP in final detok for CJK & RTL test slices. threshold 0.5% for canary.
rajesh: plan: 1) reproduce deterministically with same RNG and seed, 2) dump token id streams and map to unicode, 3) run per-kernel quant bisect if divergence persists.
mei: repro curl: curl -s -X POST https://rbw-test.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer test-key" -d '{"model":"orionx-v1-int8","input":"今日の価格は１,200－です。(続き)","max_tokens":48,"temperature":0.7,"top_p":0.9,"seed":42}'
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: orionx-v1-int8 -> sampling-test at 2025-11-22T08:00Z
